newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares add on, rise expected to continue.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares add on, rise expected to continue.

text.p: The Slovenian blue-chip SBI index firmed 0.65 percent on Monday, rising for the seventh consecutive day. Market participants forecast the index would clear 1,600 points by the end of the week.
"Strong foreign demand in the past month has initiated a winning streak that could last for months with temporary corrections," an analyst said.
* The SBI index rose 10.19 points to 1,582.67.
* Petrol trader Petrol was the most actively traded, up 1.91 percent to 25,050 tolars on volume of 3,073 shares.
